# Approved brief: FieldLog

An authenticated field technician sees assigned WorkOrders, opens one, writes a CompletionReport with optional photo references, and can save the report as an offline Draft. WorkOrder states are Assigned and Closed; the submission decision is Submitted or Conflict. A retry uses the same IdempotencyKey. A supervisor may close the WorkOrder first; submission must return Conflict, preserve the client-owned Draft without echoing its content, and retain the IdempotencyKey for traceability. Tenant data must never cross accounts. Start as a small responsive web app and modular monolith for 30 technicians. PostgreSQL is approved. No chat, billing, automatic conflict overwrite, or background location.

The approved pure decision checkpoint is stable across every handoff. For Assigned it returns `{"decision": "Submitted", "idempotencyKey": key}`. For Closed it returns `{"decision": "Conflict", "conflictReason": "WorkOrderClosed", "draftPreserved": true, "idempotencyKey": key}`. It rejects an unknown WorkOrder state, or a CompletionReport or IdempotencyKey that is blank after trimming. Durable replay, storage, authorization, and transport remain outside this checkpoint.
